name: openrct2-plugins
description: OpenRCT2 plugin monorepo: quest-board, park-dashboard, peep-stories

scripts.build: esbuild quest-board/src/plugin.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=quest-board/dist/quest-board.js && esbuild park-dashboard/src/plugin.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=park-dashboard/dist/park-dashboard.js && esbuild peep-stories/src/plugin.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=peep-stories/dist/peep-stories.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p quest-board && tsc --noEmit -p park-dashboard && tsc --noEmit -p peep-stories
